rationale: Among liquid US-listed ETFs, the asset with the strongest medium-horizon relative return tends to continue outperforming over the next rebalance window because capital reallocates with a lag. This is a cross-sectional rotation hypothesis, not an absolute trend filter on one crypto asset.
eligibility: Asset must have a completed bar on the signal date and a positive 60-session split-adjusted close-to-close return.

rules.signal: Every 20 completed sessions after a 60-session warmup, rank the universe by 60-session return.
rules.entry: Hold the single highest-ranked eligible asset. Cash if none are eligible.
rules.exit: Replace or exit at the next rebalance.
rules.execution: Next completed session open. Never the signal close.
rules.sizing: 95 percent of equity. One position. No leverage. Long only.

validation.design: chronological 70/30 split of the aligned research window

dataLimitations: OHLC is split-adjusted and dividend-unadjusted. yahooAdjClose is not used because it is revised and not point-in-time. TLT and SPY total returns are therefore understated.
